specs.Item Type Name: USB C to Lightning OTG Adapter

features: OTG Adapter for USB C Microphones--Specially designed for connecting USB C wireless microphone receivers to iPhone & iPad Lightning devices. Easily convert Type-C microphone receivers into Lightning-compatible audio input for smooth recording and streaming.

Stable Audio Transmission with OTG Support--Built-in OTG technology ensures stable and low-latency audio transmission between your Type-C microphone receiver and Apple devices. Enjoy clear sound capture without interruptions during live streaming or content creation.

Compact & Travel-Friendly Design--Mini lightweight Lightning to USB C OTG converter easily fits in your pocket or camera bag. A must-have accessory for creators using USB C microphones with iPhone, compatible with vlogging, podcasting, interviews, reels, and mobile filmmaking.
